notes: 🎮 private (offlane) was alive and never joined — get them to the fight and the count changes.
Xeebs (midlane) was alive and never joined — get them to the fight and the count changes.
Enemy had 1 healer; only 1 of us carried anti-heal — usually wants two vs a heal comp.

Enemy ran 3/5 on or near their meta core.

draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane).

coaching.headline: Four won fights, four cashed — perfect conversion turned a game of unfavored lane reads into 8-0 in towers and a 27-minute close.
coaching.team: Four of five lanes read against us and it never mattered, because every fight was fought on top of a prize and every win was banked immediately: the 12.7 2-0 at our Mini Prime, the 17.1 3-0 at our Fangtooth, the 24.6 3-1 at our inhibitor — and the ledger reads Fangtooth at 10, 17 and 24, Mini Prime at 14, Genesis Core at 20, Orb Prime at 22, with 60,874 objective damage to their 1,777. The only smudges were three early solo catches before minute 15 and the 18.8 fight lost while two of us watched from lane. This is the conversion template the squad's losses keep missing.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 3-0 at our Fangtooth at 17.1 — Renna and GRIM.exe standing two against three — broke the game open: Genesis Core fell at 20 and Orb Prime at 22, and they never took a tower all game.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Phase lost the support matchup on the read and won it on the ledger — 16,399 healing, 11 wards with 2 cleared, and a 1/2/6 line while the linked carries went 6/1 and 5/2. The 9.4 solo catch by Kira was the one loose moment.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's GRIM.exe was the finisher — 6/1 with two kills each on Kira and Aurora, present for the 12.7, 17.1 and 24.6 fights that decided the game. Standing in the 17.1 Fangtooth fight two-against-three and winning 3-0 is the play of his night.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Greystone went deathless — 3/0 with two kills on Khaimera and 34,172 mitigated — quietly holding a lane read against him. The one flag is 18.8: alive and never joining the only fight we lost; a stasis frontliner arriving there flips it.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Renna keyed both game-breaking fights — the 3-0 at our Fangtooth at 17.1 and the 3-1 at our inhibitor at 24.6, finishing 5/2/3. The 15-minute catch by Khaimera and skipping the 18.8 fight are the two clips to review; everything else was clean.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim's Shinbi did the invisible work — a team-high 30,460 objective damage plus first blood at 3.2 — which is why every won fight had a Fangtooth or Prime ready to take. All three deaths were to Khaimera, the sustain duelist his squishy wolves should not duel; with no armor bought into a three-physical comp, those solo trades were always losing ones.

threats: Heal-stacking: Aurora. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
ourKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
ourKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
enemyKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain
